proposal: Make two tracked artifact sites verifiable under a read-only acceptance rule by additive means only: add an explicit --for-commit <sha> input to tools/admit_technologies.py so the recorded candidate_head is reproducible, add an optional --out PATH to tools/history_secret_scan.py so the mandated scan need not write into the tracked tree, annotate the recorded identity's semantics, and add a machine check that the recorded identity is an ANCESTOR of HEAD and that the evidence manifest's per-entry sha256 still equals the bytes on disk (a silent-staleness gap this study discovered). No gate, schema, claim ceiling or published artifact changes; the acceptance rule is NOT narrowed.
